objective: estimate training-randomness stability of the locked two-phase CNN protocol without using the test split
replication_unit: complete stochastic training pipeline per seed on the same fixed dataset split

phase_a.initialization: official ImageNet-1K V1 backbone plus a newly seeded six-class head

phase_b.initialization: the same seed's phase-A best checkpoint
phase_b.checkpoint_selection: validation_macro_f1 including that seed's phase-A initialization as epoch 0

notes: Seed 42 was inspected repeatedly while choosing the two-phase protocol, so it is a development result. Seeds 43-46 are the remaining locked confirmation runs. They quantify optimization and augmentation randomness on one fixed split; they do not provide independent sampling uncertainty for new datasets.
